name: text
label: Text
help: The text to publish, exactly as it will appear.

name: channel_ids
label: Channels
help: The connected social channels to publish to.

name: at
label: Publish at
help: When to publish the post. Skryvo moves it to the next quarter hour. Left empty, the post goes out in about five minutes.

name: image_url
label: Image URL
help: A picture to publish with the post on every channel.

name: link
label: Link
help: A web page the post points to.

name: brand_id
label: Brand
help: The brand whose voice to use. Left empty, Skryvo uses the account's default brand.

name: tiktok
label: TikTok
help: Required for a TikTok channel: TikTok needs the audience chosen for every post.
